chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu al-Maghra, from Ammar al-Sajistani, from Abu Abdillah, from his father (peace be upon him), that

the Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) placed a rock upon the path to divert the water from his land, so by God, neither a camel nor a human being has moved it until this very hour.

key_terms.الطريق: The path or road — referring to a route along which water flowed
key_terms.نَكَبَ: To knock aside, displace, or harm — used here to emphasize the stone has never been disturbed
key_terms.يَرُدُّ الماء: To divert or redirect the water — a practical measure of land management

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad do to protect his land from water damage?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching Imam al-Baqir (AS) who transmitted it from the Prophet (SAWW), describes an act of the Prophet placing a stone to manage water flow on his property. The narrator swears by God that the stone has remained undisturbed — neither camel nor person has moved it — until the time of narration. This serves as an example of the Imams modeling their conduct after the Prophet's approach to livelihood and land stewardship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from IBn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Al Magra, from Ammar Al Sajastany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> that

Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> placed a rock upon the path to divert the water, from his<sup>saww</sup> land, so by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, neither has a camel nor a human being has moved it until this time’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Abu al-Maghra’ from ‘Am mar al-Sajistaniy from abu ‘Abd Allah, from his father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, once placed a piece of stone on the waterway to prevent it from flowing into his land. By Allah, until this day no human being or camel has moved it away.”
